subject.title: fix(memory): increase QMD embedTimeoutMs default to 600s for local GG…

question: Should OpenClaw accept a 600s QMD embed timeout default for every existing unset QMD config, or require a narrower strategy before this PR merges?
rationale: The PR changes upgrade behavior and derived lock waits for existing users, and the linked issue discussion includes both premature timeout evidence and CPU-only long-run risk evidence.

options.title: Require proof before accepting broad default
options.body: Keep the 600s default path only if maintainers accept redacted real QMD/GGUF runtime proof or explicitly override the proof gap and lock-wait tradeoff.

options.title: Narrow the timeout policy
options.body: Ask for a selective local-GGUF or opt-in strategy so existing unset QMD users do not all inherit a longer failure window.

options.title: Limit this PR to diagnostics/docs
options.body: Defer the default change and merge only the warning/docs guidance if maintainers are not ready to own the runtime behavior change.

recommendation.title: Require proof before accepting broad default
recommendation.body: Keep the 600s default path only if maintainers accept redacted real QMD/GGUF runtime proof or explicitly override the proof gap and lock-wait tradeoff.

likelyOwner.reason: osolmaz is assigned to both this PR and the canonical linked issue, making them the clearest current owner for the default/proof decision.
